```{r}

library(plotly)
#library(palmerpenguins)

#install.packages("tidyverse")
#install.packages("ggplot2")
penguins <- penguins
```

# Plots

## Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass)) +
  geom_boxplot()
ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = bill_len)) +
  geom_boxplot()
ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r, warning= FALSE}
#| title: Flipper Length By Mass
ggplot(penguins,aes(body_mass, flipper_len, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r, warning= FALSE}
#| title: Bill Length By Mass
ggplot(penguins,aes(body_mass, bill_len, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

# Data Table

This dataset describes 344 individual penguins and comes form the Palmer Penguins package. These three species of penguins live on three different islands. 

## Row 2

```{r, warning=FALSE}
penguins <- penguins |> 
  select(-c(year))


knitr::kable(penguins)
```
